content: Paulo Exahe Iraiti Xakaisaseharenae Metalahare
Kasani exahe niraehena hatyahaliti akereta hoka heko xasemaxematya niraeni naokita. Hatyo hiyeta xasemaira niraeni.

Enore waiye kaxaikotere xiso akereta tehitiya atyo natyo nokaxaikota xiso. Hiyaiya, xiso atyo hatya mawatyalisakahalotatare kaiserehare hoka nakaiyanenetya naokowitere hatya haliti kakoa akereta xisaonita. Hatyo haliti atyo Cristo.
Nomawaiyehareta xikakoa, xoana xamani hoka owi kinohare maoserahenere Eva akereta xikamaoseratyaka hoka maisa waiye xahekotyare hoka xahalakisaiya xawenane waiyexe Cristo koamaniya.

Hiyaiya, xasemita atyo xihalaharene kakoa hatyatere kaokehena hoka xakaihena Jesus hawareharexe tahi xihiye hoka. Hatyo atyo maisa Jesus aliterexe wiyakaitere xihiye tahi xini. Exahe xaokita atyo xomana isekohaliti, exahe iraiti waiye hawareharexe, wiso wiyakaihenere Enore nalitare Isekohaliti exahe Iraiti Waiyexe nonitata.
Noxahekoli hiye hoka maisa atyoala exe “iraiti kakoarenai” katyahakohare xini natyo naoka.
Exahe atyoala maisa nawaiyore niraexe naoka, xakore hoka kalore atyo waiyekehalakita nomani. Hatyoharenai atyo tyotyaki nihatyaka wahotikisa xomana.

Noxakaihenere xihiye Iraiti Waiyexe Enore nalitare xowaka maisa nobakatyaki naokita xihiye. Nikare nahakita hoka wakahare akereta notyaonita hoka kalorexe xisaona maheta. Xoana hatyo xowaka ala maisa ehekore xini nikare notyaonita xomana?
Nahahenere xinekoni xowaka haiyaharenae tyakekohatiyenae hakoa wenakalatitarenae bakatyahitaha natyo. Kala xoana xamani hoka nokaiwahitene naoka nakahinaetya xiso maheta.

Notyaohenere xinekoni xowaka haiya xowaka olo hare naokita, xakore hoka maisa xalahare nahowitikijita. Wihinaeharenae Macedônia nalita tyohenerenai atyo kolatyaha nomani xoalinihare naokitereharenae. Nikare notyaona kafaka maniya hoka nikareta tehitiya ite notyaonehitiya nahiti maniya. Maisaiya hatyoharenae hiyeta nahowitikijita xiso.

Cristo niraene aliterexe tyaonitere nohiye hiyeta niraehena, hoka tyotya Grécia koa tyaoniterenai konitareya maisa xalahare emaisahitita exe nihalahalini kakoa maxaimanehareta noxakaitere Iraiti Waiyexe.
Xoanere ala hoka exakere niraeta? Xoana maisa ala nawaiyetyare xiso hoka? Enore atyo waiyoreta noxawaiyiri xiso kakoa.
Maika Xirihare Xaotyakisatiyenae Metalahare Kakoa
Kalikini nahakitere akereta ite nahahitiya hoka etakehare “iraiti kakoarenai” xahenera namiyatya, exahe wihatene akereta hakahitaha aokowiyahitere xoaha.
Hatyo halitinai atyo iraiti kakoarenai metalaharenai, maisa atyo ekaisereharenai xini. Hahateneha tahi atyo maoseratyahitaha hoka Cristo niraene kakoarenai kaiserehare atyo aokowiyahitaha.
Xakore hoka maisaiya atyo xahakaharetyoita. Xiyaiya, Ahalakoahaliti kakoitaiya atyo aikawatyoa hoka motyaiya anjo waiyexe ene kaotyaka.

Nikare ite hoka exema maniya tyaoniterenaite nikareta tyaonaha hoka motya ite haliti waiyexe nomasehareha ene tyaonaha. Xakore hoka imiyaniki xowakehenaite hoka tyomahitere akereta kaxomokakehenahitaha.
Paulo Iraiti Xakaisasehare Makawatini
Haki ite niraehitiya: awa atyo nohatyahalini xaoka. Nohatyahareta atyo xaowita hoka maika hatyahaliti xomokaka akereta xamohena natyo hoka hatyohare hiyeta naokowiharetyoa.
Aliterexe exe niraetere atyo maisa Xekohaseti xaotyakira xini. Exe noxaokowiharetyoani tahi niraetere atyo aliterexe motya hatyahaliti akereta niraeta.
Haiyaharenae atyo hawenaneha waikohekoare kakoa aokowiharetyoahitaha, hoka natyo tehitiya ite naokowiharetyoahena nawenani kakoa.
Xiso atyo xirihare, xakore hoka waiye xasemaxemaita hatyaharexenai niraene.

Haiyanae atyo wakahare akere mokita xiso, xixiyehare miyatyahitaha xonita, maoseratyahitaha xiso, hairawaneha kakoa kaxaikoahitaha xiso, exahe mokotyahitaha harenai xiso xitihokoa. Nikare xakore atyo mokahitaha xiso hoka waiye xasemaxemaita iniraeneha.

Komitaene ene nohaihareta exakere niraeni xikakoa: maisa wiyalijiniharexe hoka hatyonai akereta wamokare xiso. Hiyaiya, maisa xakore wikinaterexe hoka exakere wiraeta xikakoa. Xakore hoka haiyanaiya atyo aokowiharetyoaha xoalini hare kakoa hoka natyo tehitiyaite naokowiharetyoa. Hiyaiya, aliterexe atyo hatyahaliti akereta niraeta.
Xoana Hebreu hotyaliharenai? Natyo tehitiya atyo. Xoana Israel hotyaliharenai? Natyo tehitiya atyo. Xoana Abraão jikolaharenai? Natyo tehitiya atyo.
Paulo Nawenane Howitihare Tyaonita

Xoana Cristo wakaneharenai? Natyo tehitiya atyo Cristo wakanehare, hatyo xahehareha atyo natyo. Alatya atyo hatyahaliti akereta niraeta hoka. Hiyaiya, exahehareha atyo nahaka, exaheharehaki atyo berexoako nokaxomokaki. Exaheharehaki atyo nokamokonasetyaki, exahe kahaliki komitaene nowaini.
Judeunae 5-ki mokonasetya natyo hoka 39-xa mokotyahitaha natyo hatyo 5-kinai mokohenahere natyo xowaka.
Hanamaki atyakase kakoa Roma yerenai mokonasetya natyo. Haki sehali kakoa mokotyaha natyo. Hanamaki kanowa kalorexe tabobokoa nokakoi. Haxatini, haferakene xoaha notyaona one kaloxere xaiya.

Kahaliki notonani xowaka kahenehare nawenani tyaonita one morene, exahe kaiwarexenai xoaha koni. Exahe kahenehare notyaonita nohinaeharenai Judeunai, exahe majudeuneharenai xoaha koni. Kahenehare notyaonita wenakalatikoanai, maharexakiti, one kaloxere xaiya, exahe kahenehare nokaxomokakita nohinaeharenai metalaharenai hiyeta.
Kahare hateniti tyaonita nomani, nokirahareta. Haiya xowaka maisa aliyakere notemakare hekoti. Haiya xowaka nonakita, nomaimihare, exahe maisa tihere niyahare nokaimiye hoka tihita nohiye.
Maiha hatyoharenai taita xini. Ferakiti nihatyaka nomawaiyehareta tyotya tyakekohatiyenae kakoa.
Haiyaharenae maotikone tyaonita hoka nomaotikoni tehitiya notyaonita. Haiyaharenai iniyalahare tyomehena hoka kalore namaikohareta.
Naokowiharetyoaiya atyo naokowita hoka naokowiharetyoahena atyoite etakehare nomaotikonini hotikijiterehare kakoa.
Enore, Xekohaseti Jesus Nexe, etake kaihalaharetyaketa menehenere ana atyo waiyekehalakita hoka maisa atyo namaoseraita xini.
Notyaohenere wenakalati Damasco xowaka kalorexe kaxaikoakaitere xekohaseti Aretas wenekoare moka sorarenai wenakalati kaokatyakala nali tokaha natyo maheta.
Xakore hoka nohinaeharenae mokaha natyo koho kalorexe ako hoka exoakihenahitaha natyo talarehoko motokoare ahota hoka maisa sorarenae xoana mokita natyo.
